question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Measures **__adopted__** by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and supported by the UN have been described as a 'game changer' for future Olympic events in terms of driving sustainability in sport and fighting climate change.
solution:
The correct answer is **"rejected."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Adopted"** means choose to take up, follow, or use. (अपनाना, अनुसरण करना या उपयोग करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *They **adopted**__ new rules.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **"adopted"** is **"rejected."**
 
• **"Rejected"** means to refuse to accept, consider, or use something. (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को अस्‍वीकार करना (मानने से इनकार करना))
 
• The sentence suggests that the measures adopted by the IOC and supported by the UN are effective in promoting sustainability and fighting climate change, so the opposite of that would be to reject those measures.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (headed)** means to be in charge of or to lead something. (निर्दिष्ट दिशा में आगे बढ़ना)
 
• **Option 3 (established)** means to set up or create something. (संस्‍था, व्‍यवस्‍था आदि स्‍थापित करना, निर्धारित करना)
 
• **Option 4 (inducted)** means to admit someone formally to a position or organization. (विशेषकर समारोह में किसी को औपचारिक रूप से कोई प्रभावशाली पद देना; विधिवत पद पर बैठाना, भरती करना)
